The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Ethical Guideline Refactoring resolution, requiring empires to use the most powerful Leader Enhancement policy available to them.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
